title: MachGang - 1st Gen
htmlContent:
MachGang shares a dope new single "1st Gen". The song "1st Gen" brings an exciting experience full of appeal on the new song. The music puts together different genres to make one amazing sound, that works together in perfect harmony. it’s exciting and creative, with appeal in the vocal performance to make a true masterpiece that you hope to find, when hitting play on a record for the first time.

MachGang’s “1st Gen” is a smashing display of music packed with talent and appeal to take this song to it’s rightful destination. Everything about this record is brilliant, with each element working in perfect harmony with the next to make it a record that doesn’t miss.
